capture.heading: Leave us your name
capture.lede: Ten seconds. Name and email is enough — we will reach out next week with your practice portal. Everything else is optional.
capture.honest: We use this email to contact you about the practitioner platform, and for nothing else. This form is not for client information — do not enter anything about a client here.
capture.footnote: Founding partners are set up as a comped practice. Nothing to enter here but your details.

errors.missing: We need a name to know who you are.

errors.rate: Too many submissions from here. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again.

thanks.heading: Got it — thank you
thanks.body: We have your details. Jacob will reach out next week to set up your portal.
